words.defn_en: special field of something or someone; kingdom:

sentences.en: In the ______ of science fiction, almost anything is possible.
sentences.zh: 在科幻小說的領域裡,幾乎任何事都有可能發生。

sentences.en: The king ruled over a vast ______ that stretched across the continent.
sentences.zh: 國王統治著一個橫跨整個大陸的廣大王國。

words.defn_en: free from error; to make right:
words.root_note: com- (thoroughly) + regere (to guide, rule), from Latin

sentences.en: Only one answer on the quiz was ______ .
sentences.zh: 測驗中只有一個答案是正確的。

sentences.en: The teacher asked him to ______ his spelling mistakes.
sentences.zh: 老師要他糾正自己的拼字錯誤。

words.defn_en: the act of correcting an error:
words.root_note: com- (thoroughly) + regere (to guide, rule), from Latin

sentences.en: The newspaper printed a ______ the next day.
sentences.zh: 這份報紙隔天刊登了一則更正啟事。

sentences.en: Her teacher's ______ s helped her improve quickly.
sentences.zh: 她老師的糾正幫助她迅速進步。

words.defn_en: capable of being corrected or set right:

sentences.en: The counselor believed the troubled teen was still ______.
sentences.zh: 這位輔導員相信這名問題青少年仍有可矯正的空間。

sentences.en: Unlike his stubborn brother, he proved to be quite ______.
sentences.zh: 與他固執的哥哥不同,他證明自己相當容易被說服改正。

words.defn_en: going in a straight line; to guide or manage:

sentences.en: Take the most ______ route to avoid traffic.
sentences.zh: 走最直接的路線以避開車流。

sentences.en: She was hired to ______ the school play.
sentences.zh: 她受邀執導這齣校園戲劇。

words.defn_en: managed or guided:

sentences.en: This new film was ______ by a renowned artist.
sentences.zh: 這部新電影是由一位知名藝術家執導的。

sentences.en: The rescue operation was carefully ______ by an experienced team leader.
sentences.zh: 這次救援行動是由一位經驗豐富的隊長細心指揮的。

words.defn_en: a period when normal government is suspended, especially between reigns:

sentences.en: The country experienced chaos during the ______ before the new king was crowned.
sentences.zh: 在新國王加冕之前,這個國家經歷了空位期的混亂。

sentences.en: The company's ______ between CEOs led to uncertainty among staff.
sentences.zh: 這家公司在執行長更替之間的過渡期讓員工感到不確定。

words.defn_en: not conforming to a standard or pattern:

sentences.en: The doctor noted an ______ heartbeat during the exam.
sentences.zh: 醫生在檢查時注意到心跳不規律。

sentences.en: Her sleeping schedule has been quite ______ this month.
sentences.zh: 她這個月的睡眠時間相當不規律。

words.defn_en: the act of correcting or setting something right:
words.root_note: rectus (straight, correct) + facere (to make), from Latin

sentences.en: The company issued a formal ______ of the misleading advertisement.
sentences.zh: 這家公司針對這則誤導性的廣告發布了一份正式的更正聲明。

sentences.en: Legal ______ of the outdated clause took several months.
sentences.zh: 這項過時條款的法律修正花了好幾個月的時間。

words.defn_en: to correct or fix something:

sentences.en: She tried to ______ her mistake with an apology.
sentences.zh: 她試圖用一句道歉來彌補她的過錯。

sentences.en: The company promised to ______ the billing error immediately.
sentences.zh: 這家公司承諾將立即糾正這項帳單錯誤。

words.defn_en: uprightness, extreme morality:

sentences.en: The judge was known throughout the county for his moral ______.
sentences.zh: 這位法官以其道德上的正直,聞名於整個郡縣。

sentences.en: Her unwavering ______ made her a trusted figure in the community.
sentences.zh: 她堅定不移的正直,讓她成為社區中備受信賴的人物。

words.defn_en: a member of the clergy in charge of a parish; the head of certain institutions:
words.root_note: rector (ruler, guide), from Latin regere (to rule, guide)

sentences.en: The ______ welcomed new members to the parish community.
sentences.zh: 這位教區牧師歡迎新成員加入這個堂區社群。

sentences.en: She was appointed ______ of the university after years of service.
sentences.zh: 在多年的服務之後,她被任命為這所大學的校長。

words.defn_en: the final section of the large intestine:
words.root_note: rectus (straight), from Latin, referring to its relatively straight shape

sentences.en: The physician recommended a screening exam of the ______ for patients over fifty.
sentences.zh: 這位醫師建議五十歲以上的病人接受直腸篩檢。

sentences.en: Inflammation of the ______ can cause significant discomfort.
sentences.zh: 直腸發炎可能會造成顯著的不適。

words.defn_en: despite the prevailing circumstances; without being deterred:

sentences.en: She decided to pursue her dream ______ of the risks involved.
sentences.zh: 儘管冒著風險,她仍決定追求她的夢想。

sentences.en: He continued working ______ of the constant criticism.
sentences.zh: 儘管持續受到批評,他仍不管不顧地繼續工作。

words.defn_en: a prescribed course of diet, exercise, or medication:
words.root_note: regimen (rule, government), from Latin regere (to rule)

sentences.en: Her strict exercise ______ helped her recover quickly from surgery.
sentences.zh: 她嚴格的運動養生法幫助她從這場手術中迅速康復。

sentences.en: The doctor prescribed a new medication ______ for his condition.
sentences.zh: 這位醫生為他的病況開立了一套新的用藥療程。

words.defn_en: reigning; currently exercising power:

sentences.en: The ______ queen presided over the ceremony herself.
sentences.zh: 這位在位的女王親自主持了這場儀式。

sentences.en: Public opinion had become the ______ force shaping the campaign.
sentences.zh: 公眾輿論已成為塑造這場競選活動的主導力量。

words.defn_en: to control or manage:

sentences.en: The government ______ nuclear energy facilities.
sentences.zh: 政府對核能設施進行管制。

sentences.en: This hormone helps ______ the body's blood sugar levels.
sentences.zh: 這種荷爾蒙有助於調節體內的血糖濃度。

words.defn_en: the period during which a monarch rules; to hold royal office:

sentences.en: The queen's ______ lasted over sixty years.
sentences.zh: 這位女王的統治長達六十多年。

sentences.en: Peace seemed to ______ throughout the kingdom during his rule.
sentences.zh: 在他的統治期間,和平似乎籠罩著整個王國。

words.defn_en: relating to a king or queen; having a grand or magnificent quality:

sentences.en: The ______ family greeted crowds from the palace balcony.
sentences.zh: 王室成員在皇宮陽台上向群眾揮手致意。

sentences.en: They received a ______ welcome upon arriving in the village.
sentences.zh: 他們抵達這座村莊時受到了盛大隆重的歡迎。

words.defn_en: not reformed or repentant; stubbornly unchanged:
words.root_note: regenerate, from Latin regenerare (to bring forth again) + un-

sentences.en: The parole board denied release to the ______ offender.
sentences.zh: 這個假釋委員會拒絕釋放這名不知悔改的罪犯。

sentences.en: He remained an ______ skeptic despite overwhelming evidence.
sentences.zh: 儘管證據確鑿,他依然是個頑固不化的懷疑論者。
